title: Open member sub-account and capture confirmation number
description: Signs on to LedgerLine Core, searches a member by member number, opens the Open Sub-Account form, fills account type, nickname and initial deposit, submits the request (irreversible; requires approval) and returns the confirmation number. Use when a new sub-account must be opened for an existing member.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member number to open the sub-account for (e.g. 10234)

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: Sub-account product type as listed in the Account Type dropdown (Money Market, Holiday Club, Share Certificate)

inputs.name: deposit
inputs.description: Initial deposit amount, numeric with two decimals (e.g. 250.00)

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: Confirmation number of the newly opened sub-account

steps.intent: Enter operator ID to sign on to LedgerLine Core

target.rationale: textbox identified by its visual-label 'Operator ID' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'opid' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins).

steps.intent: Enter operator password to sign on

target.rationale: password identified by its visual-label 'Password' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'pwd' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins).

steps.intent: Submit sign-on credentials to enter the core system

target.rationale: button identified by its content 'Sign On' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids.

steps.intent: Open Member Inquiry to look up the member and access sub-account functions

target.rationale: link identified by its content 'Member Inquiry' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: Enter the member number to look up the member record

target.rationale: textbox identified by its visual-label 'Member No.' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'mid' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins). Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.
button identified by its content 'Search' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

target.rationale: textbox identified by its visual-label 'Nickname' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'nick' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins). Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

target.rationale: button identified by its content 'Continue' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: Submit the sub-account opening request (irreversible — requires approval); goal requires submitting and reading the confirmation number

target.rationale: button identified by its content 'Submit Request' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: The goal requires reading the confirmation number from the confirmation screen

target.rationale: Value cell located by its row label 'Confirmation No.' and position 1; cell content is data and never used for targeting. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

provenance.goal: Signed on, looked up member {{inputs.member_id}}, opened a new {{inputs.account_type}} sub-account nicknamed '{{inputs.nickname}}' with a ${{inputs.deposit}} initial deposit, submitted the request, and extracted confirmation number CNF-40117.
